finalText:
Perfect! All tests are passing now. The issue was in **paginate.js:7** — the start index calculation wasn't accounting for 1-indexed pages. By changing `page * perPage` to `(page - 1) * perPage`, the function now correctly returns:

- Page 1 → indices 0-2 (items 1-3)
- Page 2 → indices 3-5 (items 4-6)
- Page 4 → index 9 (item 10)
- etc.

All 5 tests are now green.
